A walkthrough of gate queues at the skyport
The desk wrote this for visitors

Topic: Getting through gate queues with a companion animal

Travel days go smoother when you know how the Companion Animal Travel Desk handles the handoff from check-in to boarding. The goal is simple: keep your animal calm, keep the lane moving, and keep every step easy to follow. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, while the welcome team helps passengers get lined up for boarding without extra fuss.

Before you head out, make sure your carrier or leash setup matches the trip plan and that your pet can rest comfortably in it. <<FACT F057>> Bring only the items you need, keep documents close, and use calm handling from curb to gate. If your animal is sensitive to crowds, stay alert for signs of stress and give them space whenever possible.

At the desk, staff will review your setup and check that your pet is ready for the next step. <<FACT F067>> If you are traveling with more than one animal, keep each one separated and easy to identify. That makes the handoff cleaner for the team and reduces confusion in the queue.

During busy boarding periods, follow the direction of the agents and keep the carrier where they can see it. Do not open it unless a staff member tells you to. That protects your pet and helps the line keep moving. If your animal needs a pause, let the desk know right away so the team can guide you through the safest option.

For more help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before you arrive at the skyport.
